title.narrative: Strengthening the Southern African MAB Network through Effective Governance, Learning and Collaboration

description.narrative: Biosphere Reserves serve as sites for learning, innovation, biodiversity conservation and sustainable development, demonstrating how people and nature can coexist while contributing to national, regional and global priorities. The adoption of the Hangzhou MAB Strategy 2026–2035 presents an opportunity to strengthen governance mechanisms, institutional capacities, regional cooperation and knowledge exchange across the Southern African MAB Network. This project will support Member States through governance strengthening, peer learning, regional collaboration and the sharing of best practices. The initiative will also promote partnerships, youth engagement and citizen science approaches to strengthen science-policy-society linkages and support the effective implementation of the MAB Programme in Southern Africa.
